findings.claim: FY2025 10-K Item 3 says Airbnb is party to legal proceedings and government investigations incl. competition matters, but management believes resolution of all pending matters will not have a material adverse effect; no specific antitrust case or breakup is named.
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: While it is not possible to determine the outcomes, we believe based on our current knowledge that the resolution of all such pending matters will not, either individually or in the aggregate, have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, cash flows, or financial condition.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K risk factors: European Commission is conducting investigations into preferential tax treatments that may change how foreign operations are taxed; could raise effective tax rate.
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The European Commission is also conducting investigations into preferential tax treatments, which may lead to changes in how our foreign operations are taxed.

findings.claim: European Commission proposed Affordable Housing Act giving local authorities a clear legal basis to restrict Airbnb and other short-term rentals; needs approval of member states and Parliament.
findings.source: Foster Garvey, Duff on Hospitality Law: Europe moves to rein in short-term rentals

findings.source: Portfolio.hu: Hungarian competition watchdog launches investigation into Airbnb
